_comment: Thresholds for askuserquestion-clarity.py, the PreToolUse gate on AskUserQuestion.
R0: these numbers live here rather than in the hook so a machine can retune the gate
without editing Python. R4 provenance: CHOSEN, not measured - they are starting values
picked on 2026-08-30 when the gate was written, sized so that a question naming a file
and a measurement passes while a bare 'Which approach?' does not. Retune them here and
the change takes effect on the next tool call; nothing caches this file.
Deleting or breaking this file disables the gate in silence (R11); it never blocks.

_field_notes.min_question_chars: Question text floor. A question that states its origin - the file, the flag, the measurement - does not fit in less.
_field_notes.min_description_chars: Per-option description floor. Behaviour plus cost does not fit in less; a bare label restated does.
_field_notes.min_description_gain_chars: When the description contains the label verbatim, this much text must remain after removing it. Catches 'Strict' -> 'Strict mode'.
_field_notes.require_question_mark: A question ends with '?'. A statement handed to AskUserQuestion is usually a decision that was never actually put to the user.
_field_notes.require_recommended_marker: Every question carries one recommended option. Having an opinion is part of the work.
_field_notes.require_recommended_first: The recommended option is options[0], because the reader stops at the first plausible one.
_field_notes.recommended_marker: R5: the marker string is defined once, here, and never spelled again in code.
